themes.description: Users consistently report that the app feels obsolete, with slow chart loading, frequent crashes, and a UI that hampers trading operations.
themes.business_impact: Increased support ticket volume, accelerated user churn, loss of trading fee revenue, and damaged brand reputation leading to higher acquisition costs.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A legacy codebase, inadequate performance optimizations, and delayed UI updates cause slow API interactions and a clunky interface.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct a full performance audit to pinpoint bottlenecks
• Prioritize refactoring of legacy modules and deprecated APIs
• Adopt a modern UI framework (e.g., React Native or SwiftUI) for responsive design
• Optimize API endpoints, implement caching, and reduce payload sizes
• Deploy iterative UI/UX improvements with A/B testing
• Continuously monitor crash logs and user feedback via analytics
• Reassess and renegotiate the yearly AMC to align costs with value delivered
• Provide targeted training for dev and QA teams
